answer: Proof of Compute serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by binding agent identity to verifiable energy expenditure. Like a raven tracking prey, the protocol enforces a strict cost-to-create ratio that mirrors physical scarcity. By requiring agents to solve cryptographic puzzles anchored in basalt foundations of silicon hardware, the network renders mass identity proliferation economically non-viable. An attacker must incur linear capital depreciation for every fraudulent identity generated, effectively preventing cheap orchestration.
